settings.appToolbarDesc: Floating dock or a left rail for the section links
settings.languageInfo: Change the language used across the Dishylink interface. Translations are community-contributed.
settings.yourDeviceDesc: Pick the computer you are using right now
settings.yourDeviceInfo: The router lists every connected device the same way, so Dishylink cannot tell which one you are sitting at. Pick yours and it is marked "This device" in the network list, with no pause button of its own.
settings.deviceSaveFailed: That could not be saved, so nothing changed. Try again.
settings.deviceNotSelected: Until you pick one, no device can be paused.
settings.deviceMissing: The device you picked is not connected right now. Pick it again when it is back.
settings.toolbarBadgeDesc: What the count on the extension icon includes
settings.toolbarBadgeInfo: The extension icon can count every alert, device faults only, or show no badge. Alerts and notifications still work in every mode.
settings.throughputInDesc: Show the live ↓/↑ rate in the {{surface}}
settings.hideMenuBarIconDesc: Show only the throughput readout, no icon
settings.menuBarIconDesc: How it looks in the menu bar
settings.snowMeltDesc: Heats the panel to shed snow. Auto uses the dish's own sensors.
settings.snowAutoDesc: Automatically detect snow and heat up when needed.
settings.snowAlwaysDesc: Keep warm to better resist snow build-up. This option may increase power consumption.
settings.snowOffDesc: Never use extra power to melt snow.
settings.sleepScheduleOff: Power the dish down for part of every day
settings.sleepScheduleOn: Dish powers down daily at {{sleep}} and wakes at {{wake}}
settings.debugDataDesc: Diagnostics + status + config as JSON, for support or bug reports
settings.resetObstructionDesc: Wipes the learned sky survey — do this after physically relocating the dish. Takes hours to relearn.
settings.rebootStarlinkDesc: Internet drops for ~2–3 minutes while the dish restarts
settings.factoryResetStarlinkDesc: Wipes every dish setting back to how it shipped. Not reversible.
settings.rebootRouterDesc: WiFi drops for a minute or two; the dish stays up
settings.factoryResetRouterDesc: Wipes the WiFi name, password and every router setting. Not reversible.

metrics.dishNotAnswering: dish isn’t answering — no status received yet
metrics.waitingForDish: waiting for the dish’s first reply…
metrics.routerPingNote: the router's own pings to its point of presence, over a rolling five minutes
metrics.routerPingEmpty: nothing recorded in this window — the router wasn't answering, or nothing was running to record it
metrics.downloadExplainer: Download throughput is the rate data arrives from the internet to your dish, in bits per second. It spikes while you're actively pulling data and idles near zero when nothing is downloading.
metrics.uploadExplainer: Upload throughput is the rate data leaves your dish for the internet. It rises when you send files, back up data, or make video calls.
metrics.latencyExplainer: Latency measures how long, in milliseconds, a request takes to go to the internet and back. High latency can affect gaming, video calls, and browsing.
metrics.pingExplainer: It is normal for a few test pings to drop without noticeably affecting your connection. Sustained dips matter and line up with outages on the chart.
metrics.powerExplainer: Power draw is how much electricity the Starlink terminal is using. It rises under heavy load and when the dish heats itself to melt snow or ice.
metrics.searchingHelp: Dishylink talks directly to your Starlink terminal at {{address}}. Make sure this machine is connected to the Starlink network and the dish is powered. Retrying automatically…
